_comment: NPC dialogue for ysolde (Phase E §3 barks; quest lines land with Act 1).

1.speaker: Ysolde the Trader
1.text: Ysolde will trade with anyone who brings iron she can actually melt, and the slag fields are full of it.

2.speaker: Ysolde the Trader
2.text: Gather 5 Scrap Iron. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Ysolde the Trader
1.text: Ysolde buys raider insignia by weight -- brass is brass -- and the Choir's raiders are carrying more of it than they used to.

2.speaker: Ysolde the Trader
2.text: Gather 8 Raider Insignia. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Ysolde the Trader
1.text: Ysolde's awning is lizard hide and the season has eaten through it. She would rather buy it off a hunter than a tanner.

2.speaker: Ysolde the Trader
2.text: Slay 6 Slag Lizard. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Ysolde the Trader
1.text: Ysolde's caravans have stopped coming. She can price a minotaur horn to the coin and would rather not have to.

2.speaker: Ysolde the Trader
2.text: Slay 8 Ash Minotaur. Come back to me when it is done.

barks.text: Everything here came off a wagon that came off another wagon. Buy accordingly.
Ashport trades in salvage. Bring me salvage and I'll trade in coin.
You look like you've been walking the slag. Sit. Drink. Pay.
